name: Path to Ascension: Techbot does not count as a world boss, Azuregos does (#11478)
contract: Take Down a World Boss (tutorial 36, achievement 87235) reads 'Slay any World Boss.'. Techbot 6231 has rank 3 since rev_20261008_71_vanilla_dungeon_boss_rank.sql but no boss type flag (type_flags 0x80000000), and stands in Dun Morogh (map 0, spawn 10996). Every world boss (Azuregos 6109/64601, Kazzak 12397/18728, the Nightmare dragons 14887-14890, Doomwalker 17711, the world boss map bosses on maps 880-890) has rank 3 and the boss type flag 4. Killing Techbot in the open world leaves tutorial 36 unverified; killing an unowned Azuregos 6109 on the same map verifies it.

steps.label: Let the player finish logging in
Take Down a World Boss is not verified before any kill
DISCRIMINATING: killing Techbot does not verify Take Down a World Boss
Bring an unowned Azuregos into the open world
Killing a real world boss verifies Take Down a World Boss
